name: Ring of Blindness
body:
Aura moderate divination; CL 6th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of x-ray vision, though it does not function as such. When the wearer attempts to use the ring’s perceived abilities, he must make a DC 20 Will save or be struck blind as per blindness/deafness.

The ring can be removed freely. The blindness remains until magically cured. If the wearer does not also have remove curse cast upon him after being cured, the blindness returns in 1d4 days.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of x-ray vision

Identification DC 31
False Identification DC 21
